{{Quote|I'm sure you know how we Duloks love to torture Ewoks. Well, your torture will be the most exquisite of all: babysitting the Dulok brats.|translated=1|Gorneesh, to Latara|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
[[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Urgah]], monarchs of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], had several [[Youngling/Legends|cubs]], '''one''' of whom was a toddler in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The [[Gender/Legends|male]] pup already showed characteristics typical of the Dulok [[Species/Legends|species]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], such as [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]], and on at least one occasion, he wore the red [[Skeleton/Legends|shells]] of some creature as shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]]. When the combined mischief of he and [[Unidentified Dulok cub 2|his]] [[Unidentified Dulok cub 3|siblings]] proved too much for his [[Parent/Legends|mother]], Urgah demanded that Gorneesh find a babysitter for the tykes. The Dulok King hatched a plan that eventually brought the female [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] to the [[Dulok Swamp]] as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] tasked with minding the three cubs. Nevertheless, while the pups watched a performance of a group of itinerate [[Entertainer|performers]] known as the [[Travelling Jindas]], Latara's friends rescued her.

==Biography==
{{Quote|&hellip;miserable, monstrous, misbehaving brats! I can't stand it anymore! If I don't get a babysitter, you don't get any supper!&raquo;<br />&laquo;Hmm. Don't worry, my dear. I've just had an evil inspiration.|translated=1|Urgah's ultimatum gives Gorneesh an idea|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
[[File:DulokBratBitingTail-TTJ.png|thumb|left|180px|The Dulok Prince tested his mother's patience by biting her tail.]]
As one of the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Urgah]], a [[Skeleton/Legends|shell]]-wearing, [[Gender/Legends|male]] Dulok cub had at least two siblings, [[Unidentified Dulok cub 2|one of whom]] was a child who wore a [[Color/Legends|pink]] shoulder wrap, and [[Unidentified Dulok cub 3|one of whom]] wore no clothing. They lived in the home of their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] in the [[Dulok Swamp]], an area of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] dominated by members of [[Gorneesh's tribe]] of Duloks. The Dulok [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] at some point before [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in which he was a toddler.<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

One day that year, the Dulok cub joined his siblings in harassing Urgah while she attempted to wash clothes in the family hut. While his siblings pulled on the matriarch's [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and chomped on her [[Limb/Legends|knee]], the Prince grabbed his mother's tail and bit down. The combined assault prompted Urgah to provide an ultimatum to her husband: either he would find a babysitter for the youngsters, or he would go supperless. Unfazed, Gorneesh dispatched [[Unidentified Dulok (X)|two]] of his [[Unidentified Dulok (O)|guards]] to travel to [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], home to a group of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], to find a caretaker for the children. The [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] eventually returned to the swamp with a trussed up female Ewok named [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] in their clutches. As Gorneesh divulged the Ewok's [[Torture/Legends|torturous]] fate&mdash;to babysit the Dulok cubs&mdash;the toddlers scrambled into the hut and pounced on the newcomer, initiating a furious play-brawl.<ref name="TTJ" />

As evening approached, a group of wandering [[entertainer]]s known as the [[Travelling Jindas]] arrived in the Dulok swamp and were granted permission to perform. The trio of young Duloks dragged their babysitter to the show, which compelled them to sit still as they watched the performances. Nevertheless, the Prince and his siblings laughed along with the rest of the tribe as audience members hurled pieces of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] at the stage in an effort to disturb the proceedings. Still, the act put on by the [[Jinda/Legends|Jinda]] [[Magic/Legends|magician]] [[Trebla]] entranced the Dulok toddlers; when their babysitter was called onto the stage to assist the conjurer, the pups could only watch passively as Latara's friends&mdash;the Ewoks [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], all disguised as Jindas&mdash;rescued her from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] to Gorneesh and Urgah.<ref name="TTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:BratlingsWatchTheJindas-TTJ.png|thumb|right|180px|Only a performance of the Travelling Jindas could calm the Dulok child down.]]
{{Quote|Watch it! Get away, little bark eaters! Oh, ''kvark.''|translated=1|Latara, upon being tackled by Gorneesh and Urgah's children|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
Gorneesh and Urgah's son was a mischievous creature who had little compunction about misbehavior; in fact, his mischief was so severe that his parents likened watching him to torture. In one instance, the Prince joined two of his siblings in terrorizing his mother, Urgah; the pup laughed maniacally while pulling Urgah's tail and then biting down on it. In another example, the Dulok cub eagerly tackled his Ewok babysitter, Latara, embroiling her in a fracas on the floor of Gorneesh's domicile. Nevertheless, the boy was entranced by the show put on by the Travelling Jindas.<ref name="TFTEW">''[[Tales from the Endor Woods]]''.</ref>

A mere child in 3 ABY,<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="BTM" /> the pup already had developed physical features characteristic of his [[Species/Legends|species]], including green fur, brown eyebrows, a brown [[Nose/Legends|nose]], and gray skin. The child had white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. As a toddler, he stood only knee-high to a typical 1.35-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall adult Dulok.<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="height" /> While under the care of the Ewok Latara, the cub wore a pair of red shells as shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]], much like those worn by his father, Gorneesh. The child also sported a yellow stripe that ran from his bottom lip, across his chin, and onto his chest. At the time, the cub had two [[Tooth/Legends|incisors]] growing from the top of his mouth, but only a single canine tooth from his lower jaw.<ref name="TTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorneesh and Urgah's son appears as one of three such toddlers in ''[[The Travelling Jindas]]'', an episode from the first season of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] cartoon series that was written by [[Bob Carrau]] and directed by [[Raymond Jafelice]].<ref name="TTJ" /> The episode originally aired on [[October 5]], [[1985]];<ref name="SWC">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> it was later included as part of the straight-to-[[Star Wars home video releases|DVD]] feature film ''[[Tales from the Endor Woods]]'' in [[2004]].<ref name="TFTEW" /> As established in [[Ewoks (1985) 13|''Ewoks'' 13]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[May]] [[1987]], Gorneesh and Urgah had a son named [[Boogutt]].<ref name="E13">[[Ewoks (1985) 13|''Ewoks'' (1985) 13]].</ref> However, as the Dulok from ''The Travelling Jindas'' goes unnamed in the episode, identifying him as Boogutt is impossible.<ref name="TTJ" />
